description: List the user wallets registered in Hey Anon: display name, type (evm, solana, ton, etc.), address, labels and whether the wallet is archived. Call it before ask_anon to choose which addresses to attach (at most one per type); match the wallet the user names by display name, label or address and skip archived wallets. The same addresses are used by the portfolio_* tools.
name: wallet_list
title: List wallets
